resources.string: RosSwap enables contact between users who wish to trade or exchange goods and services, especially in connection with Roskilde Festival 2025 and its surroundings. RosSwap is a non-commercial school project developed in collaboration between DTU students and Roskilde Festival. The platform is not officially affiliated with Roskilde Festival.

• You are responsible for your own posts and transactions
 • You must be at least 18 years old
 • You must provide accurate information
 • You agree to receive messages from other users.
 • All use is at your own risk
It is your responsibility as a buyer and seller to ensure that all goods and services are legal:

• Investigate whether the item can be legally traded.
 • Respect age limits (alcohol, tobacco, etc.).
 • Check if permissions or licenses are required.
 • If in doubt – ask or avoid making the deal!

• Only buy sealed/unopened food
 • Check expiration dates
 • Avoid homemade food from strangers
 • Be careful with dairy and meat
• RosSwap is not responsible for trades\n • Quality and safety are not guaranteed\n • Contact authorities for serious issues
Violations will result in immediate suspension and may be reported to authorities.

• Use the flag function to report inappropriate posts.
 • Report posts that violate the law or our rules.
 • Contact us for serious violations.
 • Do not get involved in dubious deals.

• Check expiration dates carefully.
 • Prescription medicine must NOT be traded.
 • Be careful with vitamins and supplements.
 • Ask a pharmacist if in doubt.

• Meet in public places with many people.
 • Bring a friend if possible.
 • Tell someone where you are going.
 • Do not pay in advance to strangers.
 • Trust your instincts.
 • Leave the situation if something feels wrong.

• RosSwap is not responsible for trades between users.
 • We do not guarantee the quality or safety of items.
 • All trading is at your own risk.
 • For problems, contact the police, not RosSwap.
Important: RosSwap only serves as a contact platform. We:

• Do not guarantee the quality or condition of items.
 • Are not responsible for disputes between users.
 • Cannot guarantee uptime or flawless operation.
 • Reserve the right to shut down the service without notice.
